visual_action: A montage of scenes from a public memorial in a snowy location. There are close-ups of flowers, teddy bears, candles, and handmade signs left in the snow. A young child is seen placing a stuffed animal on the pile. Other shots show a large crowd gathered at night for a candlelight vigil. The video also shows a Black woman outdoors, painting a large portrait of a blonde woman.
